name: opengraph-io
description: Read and inspect public web pages: Open Graph metadata, page content as Markdown, screenshots, brand identity, social images and Open Graph Audits, from OpenGraph.io.

interface.longDescription:
OpenGraph.io lets ChatGPT read and inspect public web pages for you. Give it a URL and it can:

• Show how a link will look when shared, from its Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata
• Turn a page into clean Markdown to summarize or quote
• Capture a screenshot of a page
• Answer questions about a page, or pull specific elements out of it
• Describe a company's brand: logo, colors, fonts and description
• Audit the social metadata of a single page or a whole site, track scores over time and keep a list of fixes
• Generate social images such as OG cards, icons and illustrations

Sign in with your OpenGraph.io account to connect. Requests count toward the usage already included in that account.
defaultPrompt: How will https://github.com look when shared on social media?
What logo, colors and fonts does stripe.com use?

positive.description: Link preview metadata for a public URL
positive.prompt: What title, description and image does https://github.com show when it is shared on social media?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls getOgData with https://github.com and reports the page's Open Graph title, description and image URL.
Calls getOgScreenshot with the URL and returns a link to the captured screenshot of the Wikipedia homepage.

positive.prompt: Get the main content of https://ogp.me as Markdown and summarize it in three bullet points.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls getOgMarkdown with https://ogp.me, then summarizes the Open Graph protocol page in three bullet points.

positive.description: Brand identity for a company domain
positive.prompt: What logo, brand colors and fonts does stripe.com use?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls getBrandIntelligence for stripe.com and reports the logo URL, main brand colors as hex values and font families.

positive.prompt: Audit the Open Graph tags on https://www.opengraph.io and tell me what to fix.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls previewPageAudit with the URL and reports the score, its label and each issue found with a suggested fix.

negative.description: Creative writing with no web page involved
negative.prompt: Write a haiku about autumn leaves.

negative.description: General knowledge question with no URL
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP.
